name: Can I request specific details or ask questions during a virtual home tour?

mainEntity.name: Can I request specific details or ask questions during a virtual home tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a pre-recorded virtual tour doesn't allow for real-time interaction, many real estate agencies, including ours, offer live virtual showings. During a live showing, your agent can walk through the property with you via video call, answering questions and focusing on specific features you request in real-time. This first-party insight provides a personalized experience, allowing you to clarify details about amenities, room dimensions, or even the view from a specific window, enhancing your understanding beyond a static tour.
acceptedAnswer.description: For static tours, questions are post-viewing. For live virtual showings, you can ask questions and request specific views in real-time with your agent.
